chunks: Marry a dark-skinned, wide-eyed, full-figured, medium-height woman; if you dislike her, then the dowry is upon me.

key_terms.عَجْزَاءَ: A full-figured woman, especially with prominent hips.
key_terms.عَيْنَاءَ: A woman with large or wide eyes.
key_terms.مَرْبُوعَةً: A woman of medium height and balanced stature.

ai.seo_question: What qualities are mentioned in this hadith as recommended in choosing a wife?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام a recommendation concerning desirable qualities in choosing a wife. It presents a concise statement about marital preference and encouragement in marriage, expressed with emphatic assurance regarding the dowry.
